rows.section: State income tax on personal income after AM-bidrag: combined marginal rates (2026 reform)
rows.label: Bundskat (on income above the personal allowance)
rows.basis: Personal income after AM-bidrag, per year
rows.note: Sums of the statutory rates (each tax is charged on the income above its own threshold). Kommuneskat (national average 25.049%) and, for members of the Church of Denmark, kirkeskat come on top; the tax ceiling of 44.57% reduces the mellemskat rate in municipalities with a high kommuneskat (see each region's page).

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Income tax for the self-employed
rows.value: Business profit is taxed with the same state, municipal and church taxes as salary; income tax and AM-bidrag are paid as B-tax in ten monthly instalments
rows.note: AM-bidrag is charged on business profit as on salary. Under the business tax scheme the provisional 22% is credited when the profit is later taken out and taxed as personal income.
rows.source_title: Skattestyrelsen (skat.dk): Am-bidrag (arbejdsmarkedsbidrag)
